CTSDND35.ActorSheetVisualThemeHint: Rounded cards or angled / hex-style panels on the character sheet (client setting).
CTSDND35.GroupFilterHint: Show actors that have a matching Faction item or legacy groups text.
CTSDND35.FactionPresetsHint: One name per line. Used as suggestions in the Actors sidebar filter dropdown.
CTSDND35.DirectoryTypeToolbarsHint: Show compact wrapped filter chips inside the Scenes, Actors, Items, and Macros sidebar panels (instead of extra sidebar tab buttons). Turn off for a stock Foundry directory header.
CTSDND35.SceneFilterNavHint: Show only scenes placed on the navigation bar
CTSDND35.SceneFilterNonNavHint: Show only scenes not on the navigation bar
CTSDND35.FactionRefreshSheets: Apply to all actors & refresh sheets
CTSDND35.FactionRefreshSheetsHint: GM only: saves this faction from the form (even if you have not closed the sheet), updates every matching faction item on all world actors (same compendium/source link, or same name), syncs group strings for everyone, then redraws open CTS sheets. Same display name on different factions will all be updated.
CTSDND35.FactionRefreshNeedsGM: Only a GM can push faction changes to all actors.
CTSDND35.FactionRefreshSheetsDone: Updated {embeddedUpdated} other matching faction item(s); synced groups on all {actorsTotal} actors; redrew {sheetsRedrawn} open sheet(s).
CTSDND35.MerchantWalletEquivHint: Total coin value expressed in gold pieces
CTSDND35.MerchantEmptyStock: No goods in stock. Add weapons, armor, equipment, or consumables on this NPC's Inventory tab.
CTSDND35.MerchantNothingToSell: Nothing eligible to sell (weapons, armor, equipment, consumables only).
CTSDND35.MerchantFootnote: Prices use each item's Price field (gp), merchant multipliers below, and Trade & factions percent modifiers on buyer and seller.
CTSDND35.MerchantHint: Put shop stock on this NPC like any inventory. Set quantity and Price (gp) per item. Open the shop as whichever PC is selected or assigned.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorInvalidActor: That actor is missing or invalid.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorNotEnabled: Turn on "This NPC is a merchant" above and save the sheet.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorNoBuyer: Select a PC token on the canvas or assign a player character to use as the buyer.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorNoPermission: You cannot trade for that character.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorBadItem: That item cannot be traded at this shop.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorZeroPrice: That transaction has no valid price.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorMerchantFunds: The merchant does not have enough coin on hand.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorPurchaseOnly: This merchant does not purchase goods from characters.
CTSDND35.MerchantErrorTimeout: Timed out waiting for the GM.
CTSDND35.Help.Title: CTS DND 3.5 — Help
CTSDND35.Help.MenuHint: Open the CTS DND 3.5 in-game help guide (merchants, coins, trade modifiers, and troubleshooting).
CTSDND35.Help.Intro: This window explains how to use built-in world features for this system: merchant shops, coins, and trade modifiers. Open it from the sidebar gear → Settings tab → Help and Documentation (CTS DND 3.5 — Help), or from Game Settings → Configure Settings.
CTSDND35.Help.MerchantLead: Buy from an NPC's inventory and optionally sell eligible gear back. You do not need the Item Piles module for this.
CTSDND35.Help.GmSetupH3: GM: make an NPC a merchant
CTSDND35.Help.GmSetup1: Create or open an NPC actor.
CTSDND35.Help.GmSetup3: In the Shop section, enable "This NPC is a merchant".
CTSDND35.Help.GmSetup4: Save the sheet so the flag persists.
CTSDND35.Help.RowPurchaseOnlyDesc: Customers can buy but cannot sell items back.
CTSDND35.Help.RowBuyMultDesc: Multiplier on each item's Price before racial/faction trade rules (default 1).
CTSDND35.Help.RowSellMultDesc: Multiplier when the NPC buys loot from PCs (default 0.5).
CTSDND35.Help.Stock1: Add goods on the NPC's Inventory tab (drag from compendiums or the Items sidebar).
CTSDND35.Help.Stock2: Supported types: weapon, armor, equipment, consumable.
CTSDND35.Help.Stock3: Set each item's Price (gp book value).
CTSDND35.Help.StockNote: Spells, feats, classes, and similar types never appear in the shop lists.
CTSDND35.Help.CoinBody: When a PC sells to the merchant, the NPC pays from its Currency fields on the Inventory tab. If it cannot afford the payout, the sale fails. Give the NPC enough PP/GP/SP/CP before play.
CTSDND35.Help.OpenShop1: The buyer must be a player character. Select that PC's token on the canvas, or set an assigned character in your user configuration.
CTSDND35.Help.OpenShop2: On the merchant NPC sheet → Inventory → Shop, click Open shop.
CTSDND35.Help.OpenShopBullet1: You see the buyer's coins and buy/sell tables with final prices.
CTSDND35.Help.OpenShopBullet2: Sell is hidden if Purchase only is enabled.
CTSDND35.Help.OpenShopBullet3: Listed prices include Trade & factions modifiers for the current buyer.
CTSDND35.Help.SocketNote: If you are a player and the GM owns the merchant, trades are sent to the GM briefly so inventory and coins update correctly.
CTSDND35.Help.ApiNote: Use when you want a toolbar macro instead of opening the NPC sheet.
CTSDND35.Help.TradeP1: Faction items and Trade & factions rows adjust percentages the same way for merchant windows as elsewhere.
CTSDND35.Help.TradeLi1: Enter race text on buyer and seller when using race-based rows.
CTSDND35.Help.TradeLi2: NPC sheet "race mods selling" pairs with the buyer's "race trade mods".
CTSDND35.Help.TradeP2: When unsure, read the prices in the shop window—they already reflect the selected buyer.
CTSDND35.Help.CurrencyLi1: Actor wallets use CP, SP, GP, PP on the sheet.
CTSDND35.Help.CurrencyLi2: Shops use standard exchange: 10 cp = 1 sp, 10 sp = 1 gp, 10 gp = 1 pp.
CTSDND35.Help.FixRow1Issue: Open shop warns or does nothing
CTSDND35.Help.FixRow1Check: Merchant enabled and saved? Buyer token selected or assigned character set?
CTSDND35.Help.FixRow2Check: Add coins to the NPC merchant actor.
CTSDND35.Help.FixRow3Check: Item Price field, merchant multipliers, Trade tab, faction items.
CTSDND35.Help.FixRow4Check: They must own their character (Foundry permissions).
CTSDND35.Help.DocFileNote: The same text ships as WORLD-FEATURES.md under systems/CTS-DND-35/docs if you want to read or search it outside Foundry.
